title: NBN POI 3FSR (Footscray), 3STK (St Kilda), 2MIR (Miranda) - Upgrade Existing Infrastructure
current_summary: Network maintenance is scheduled that may affect NBN services in Footscray and St Kilda (VIC) and Miranda (NSW). Work window: Monday 10 August, 12:00 AM–7:00 AM AEST. Services may experience interruptions for up to 7 hours during the window. We will monitor throughout and work to minimise impact.

updates.content: We will be carrying out network maintenance that may affect NBN services in Footscray and St Kilda (VIC) and Miranda (NSW). The work is scheduled for Monday 10 August from 12:00 AM to 7:00 AM AEST. During this window, services in these areas may experience interruptions for up to 7 hours. Our team will monitor the works and work to minimise any impact. No action is required. If your service remains offline after 7:00 AM, please reboot your modem/router and contact our support team.
